chapter: Growing up and learning in New Orleans
title: Early New Orleans playing by ear, practice, travel, and the Waifs' Home band
summary: Armstrong explains how early bands had one reader and the rest played by ear, talks about warming up and touring with his wife, and recalls learning cornet at thirteen in the Waifs' Home band and the handkerchief habit of players.
